groups.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: first supplied sprite atlas. Other images are reference-only Toby and Momo seated sprites defining the desired head/body proportions. Edit ALL eight characters in target (Mike, Chloe, Gary, Mia, Leo, Ivy, Hank, Jill, left to right) to have 15–20% smaller heads relative to their bodies, matching Toby/Momo's less bobble-headed proportions. Show a slightly longer torso with a natural neck transition; total seated silhouette height, feet baseline, hip-to-seat contact and pose stay fixed. Do NOT just shrink whole characters. Maintain identities, outfit designs and colors, hair colors, age cues and species (Ghost remains sheet ghost, Old Fox fox, God Eye robed eye). Exact same eight-column four-row layout, rows front / left-facing / right-facing / back. Every character has every direction, same scale and center within cells. Crisp pixel art with simple distinct dark pixel eyes and filled skin-colored hands, no blurry eyes or black holes inside hands. Head including hair approximately 40–43% of total seated silhouette, preserve distinctive hats without enlarging faces. Transparent background, generous transparent gutters separating all 32 figures, no text, no grid, no chairs, no scenery, no floor shadows, no cropping. Landscape 4:3 atlas.
